children: The bank’s vehicle finance portfolio has grown as it expands lending across new and pre-owned vehicles ahead of its planned transition to a universal bank
AU Small Finance Bank’s vehicle loan portfolio has crossed the Rs 50,000 crore mark, adding another milestone to the lender’s vehicle finance business.

As of August 2026, the portfolio stood at around Rs 50,000 crore. New vehicle finance accounted for Rs 30,752 crore, while pre-owned vehicle finance contributed Rs 17,966 crore. The portfolio also included around Rs 1,767 crore in other vehicle finance.

The bank has its roots in vehicle financing, having started the business in 1996 before becoming a small finance bank in 2017. It now offers a wider range of retail and commercial banking products across its network.
Vehicle lending continues to be an important part of AU Small Finance Bank’s loan book, with the lender serving customers across both new and used vehicle segments.

The growth comes as the bank expands its lending operations and prepares for its transition into a universal bank. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) had granted AU Small Finance Bank in-principle approval to become a universal bank in August 2025.
The bank’s overall gross loan portfolio stood at Rs 1,44,250 crore as of 30 June 2026, up 23 per cent year-on-year.
Focus On Expansion Ahead Of Universal Bank Transition
AU Small Finance Bank has been expanding beyond its traditional lending businesses as it prepares for the next phase of growth.
The bank had 2,920 touchpoints across 21 states and four Union Territories as of June 2026. Its total deposits stood at Rs 1,57,727 crore, while shareholders’ funds were at Rs 20,885 crore.
The vehicle loan milestone comes at a time when AU Small Finance Bank is strengthening its management team and broadening its product offering ahead of the proposed universal banking transition.
